mapper.sql: ( select a.* from ( SELECT PBC_PROD_ID, PROD_ID, OPERATE_MODE, IVSTORIENTATION,VDATE, STATUS, RAISE_ENDDATE, ORG_CODE, ISSUE_PARTY_ID, row_number() OVER (partition BY PBC_PROD_ID ORDER BY IFNULL(UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_TIME) DESC) AS myrank FROM PBC_COL_PRD_BASEINFO_SUB ) a WHERE a.myrank=1 )
( SELECT INSIDE_PROD_ID, PBC_CODE FROM PBC_PROD_ASSETPOOL_CODE WHERE STATUS = 'E' AND CODE_TYPE = '01' )
mapper.delete: delete from PBC_DATA_COLLECT_DAT_FILE t where DAT_FILE_NAME = #{datFileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT distinct b.PBC_PROD_ID as pbcCode,t2.pbc_code as pbcProjectCodeExternal from ( select a.* from (SELECT PBC_PROD_ID,PROD_ID, row_number() OVER (partition BY PBC_PROD_ID ORDER BY ifnull(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) DESC) AS myrank FROM pbc_col_prd_baseinfo_sub where PBC_PROD_ID is not null) a WHERE a.myrank=1 ) b LEFT JOIN( SELECT inside_prod_id, pbc_code FROM pbc_prod_assetpool_code WHERE status='E' AND code_type='01' )t2 ON t2.inside_prod_id=b.PROD_ID
